narrative.overview: Warm paper, navy evidence and purple actions unify the existing property imagery and atlas compositions. Georgia headlines provide an editorial voice; Manrope keeps controls and data legible.
dos: Do preserve the existing imagery, atlas forms, interactions and factual caveats.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and respect reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't treat the shared type sizes as universal: small labels and chart annotations retain documented exceptions.
Don't substitute decorative shadows for the existing paper, border and tonal hierarchy.
